title: Pure Performage
summary: Pure Performage circus swarm and Xyz climbing deck, featuring modern legacy Pendulum monsters and generic Extra Deck bosses. Performages continuously replace each other when sent to the GY, banished, or destroyed, cycling into Rank 4 and Rank 5 Trapeze Magician bosses with damage reflection and multi-attack capabilities.

summary.title: Starters & Setup
points: Performage Fire Dancer: Normal Summon starter that searches any Performage monster from Deck to hand upon summon.
Performage Damage Juggler: Hand trap preventing effect damage and GY banish tutor that searches any Performage monster.
Performage Plushfire: Special Summons a Performage monster from the Deck whenever destroyed by battle or card effect.
Performage Trick Clown: Detaches or hits the GY to immediately revive a Performage monster at the cost of 1000 LP.
Performage Hat Tricker & Performage Water Dancer: Free summon extenders that hit the board whenever two monsters exist or from the Pendulum Scale.

summary.title: Opening Play
steps: Normal Summon Performage Fire Dancer to search Performage Trick Clown or Performage Hat Tricker.
Place Performage Plushfire and Performage Water Dancer in the Pendulum Zones.
Special Summon Performage Hat Tricker from hand since 2 monsters are face-up on the field.
Overlay Performage Fire Dancer and Performage Hat Tricker to Xyz Summon Performage Trapeze Magician.
Detach Performage Fire Dancer to grant a monster a second attack during the Battle Phase.
Rank up or climb into Performage Trapeze High Magician or Performage Shadow Maker, or link into S:P Little Knight or Exceed the Pendulum.
Trigger floating effects of detached materials to maintain full board presence into the opponent's turn.

summary.title: Bosses & Control
points: Performage Trapeze High Magician: Rank 5 Xyz immune to destruction while retaining materials, reflecting all effect damage back to the opponent.
Performage Trapeze Magician: Rank 4 enabler preventing small battle/effect damage and enabling double attacks on your offensive threats.
Performage Trapeze Witch: Fusion boss summoned with Polymerization that protects Performages from targeting and shrinks opposing ATK.
Performage Shadow Maker: Rank 5 utility Xyz that recurs Performage resources.
Number F0: Utopic Draco Future & S:P Little Knight: Generic bosses providing monster negation, permanent monster theft, and targeted banishment.

summary.title: Spells & Traps
points: Polymerization: Searched by Performage Water Dancer when Pendulum Summoned to fuse into Performage Trapeze Witch.
Trick Box: Normal Trap that steals control of an opponent's monster when a Performage is destroyed by battle or card effect.

main: Performage Fire Dancer
Newest starter: searches another Performage when summoned.
Performage Damage Juggler
Negates burn from the hand; from the GY, searches a Performage.
Performage Trick Clown
Revives a Performage when sent to the GY.
Performage Plushfire
Summons a Performage from the Deck when destroyed; revives from the Scale.
Performage Water Dancer
Scale that summons itself; adds Polymerization when Pendulum Summoned.
Performage Ball Balancer
Summons itself next to a Performage; adds a Performage Pendulum to the Extra Deck.
Performage Hat Tricker
Summons itself with two monsters on the field; absorbs burn.
Performage Wind Drainer
Summons itself and lowers its Level for the Rank 4s.
Performage Cup Tricker
Summons itself by detaching an Xyz material; recovers a Pendulum to the hand.
Polymerization
Generic Fusion Spell for Performage Trapeze Witch; Water Dancer fetches it.
Trick Box
Steals a monster when a Performage is destroyed.
extra: Newest Rank 5: indestructible with materials; reflects effect damage.
Rank 4: ignores small damage and gives a second attack.
Rank 5: searches a Rank-Up-Magic and revives a Performage.
Fusion: Performages can't be targeted; shrinks attackers.
Rank 0 Xyz: stacks on Utopic Future, cannot be destroyed by battle or effects, and negates and steals monster effects.
Link-2: banishes a card on the field/GY on summon and banishes 2 face-up monsters until the End Phase as a Quick Effect.
Link-3: adds a face-up Pendulum from Extra Deck to hand and Special Summons a Pendulum monster from hand or GY.
